name: item-in-lava
comment: WP-2.1. A still-lava pool (id 11) one deep at (-1..1, 60, -1..1) in the stone platform, stone under it. Item 0 falls into it from (0.5, 64, 0.5): EntityItem.onUpdate throws it up with Entity.rand draws and a fizz (EntityItem.java:46-51), Entity.onEntityUpdate's handleLavaMovement / setOnFireFromLava hit it for 4 and set fire 600 (Entity.java:255-277), moveEntity's isBoundingBoxBurning deals 1 (Entity.java:521-532, EntityItem.dealFireDamage ignores fire immunity), so its health of 5 runs out and it dies. Item 1 rests on the stone at (4.5, 61.125, 0.5) as a control. Item 2 starts low in the lava at (-0.5, 60.875, -0.5), where handleLavaMovement's shrunken box (expand(-0.1, -0.4, -0.1)) spans no block but posY is in a lava block: EntityItem.onUpdate's lava bounce draws its motion from Entity.rand, moveEntity's burn deals 1 and counts ++fire from 0 (Entity.java:522-529); the bounce carries it out onto the stone, where it lives with health 4. entity_state and rng_state every tick.
